title: Checkpoints and Rollback — Why Checkpoint
desc: Snapshots taken before risky steps let you undo agent mistakes and resume from a known good point.
objectives: Explain the value of undo for agents.

title: Checkpoints and Rollback — What to Snapshot
titleKn: Checkpoints ಮತ್ತು Rollback — ಏನು Snapshot ಮಾಡಬೇಕು
desc: Code is easy to snapshot; databases, external services and side effects need more thought.
objectives: Recognise effects that cannot be rolled back.

title: Checkpoints and Rollback — Rehearsing Rollback
desc: A rollback you have never tried may fail when you need it, so practise and verify it.
objectives: Test restores in a safe environment.
builderEn: [{"type":"heading","data":{"textEn":"Checkpoints and Rollback — Rehearsing Rollback","textKn":"Checkpoints and Rollback — Rehearsing Rollback","level":"H1"}},{"type":"concept","data":{"headingEn":"Lesson Info","headingKn":"Lesson ಮಾಹಿತಿ","bodyEn":"• Type: Concept · Time: ~25 minutes · Part 3 of 3 in Checkpoints and Rollback","bodyKn":"• Type: Concept · Time: ~25 ನಿಮಿಷಗಳು · Part 3 of 3"}},{"type":"concept","data":{"headingEn":"Practise Restores","headingKn":"Restore ಅಭ್ಯಾಸ","bodyEn":"Regularly restore from a checkpoint in a test environment and confirm the system works.
